game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek, a mossy forest creek: the forest ranger must hold off shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Volley Counter: Fire a volley of shots with for shot in range(volley) at oncoming shadow wolves.
theme: Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek: a mossy forest creek
core_gameplay_loop: In Mossy Creek, repeat each round: Fire a volley of shots with for shot in range(volley) at oncoming shadow wolves. Then check ammo and advance.
player_objective: Protect the mushroom ring from shadow wolves in Mossy Creek: keep ammo above zero until the 26-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Volley Counter
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 5, Level 2, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
